name: @chunkly/extension
description: Chunkly 浏览器插件：DOM 提取、意群标注渲染、设置页

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && vite build --config vite.options.config.ts && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && vite build --config vite.background.config.ts && node scripts/copy-manifest.mjs
scripts.dev: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && node scripts/copy-manifest.mjs && concurrently -n options,content,background "vite build --config vite.options.config.ts --watch" "vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --watch" "vite build --config vite.background.config.ts --watch"
